spoken_summary: An off-screen reporter asks President Biden, "What's your advice to the next House speaker?" Biden smiles and replies, "That's above my pay grade."
audio_music: An upbeat, high-energy pop/dance track ("Scream & Shout" by will.i.am and Britney Spears) plays throughout the clip, giving it a confident, swaggering, and humorous tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, uncut shot of the interaction, similar to a static talking-head clip.

central_claim: President Biden is portrayed as confidently and humorously unconcerned with the disarray in the House of Representatives regarding its speakership.
intended_effect: To make the viewer see President Biden as cool, witty, and above the political fray of his opponents.
